title: content/home/home.json
description: M7-04 — the loc keys the Home screen (S03) renders. What is fixed here is that the screen shows a Legend Level label, an Energy label, an Energy Reserve label, one primary action caption per run decision, and one status line per state the screen can be in while it has nothing to act on — and that every one of them is a key rather than a literal (X-04). Every value is a loc key, so ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences resolves it against every locale file: a key this document names but a locale does not carry fails the build, and a locale string this document stops naming fails it as an orphan. additionalProperties is false on every object so the absences are enforced rather than merely observed: there is no member for an Energy maximum, a regeneration countdown, a Legend-XP percentage or a run Energy cost, because those are functions of tuning that only Core can evaluate and a slot here would invite a second copy of the formula.

locKey.description: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments — the same shape schema/loc.schema.json governs the locale files by.

label.description: The captions beside the header values the player snapshot carries. Energy and Energy Reserve are two separate banks and are labelled separately: one caption over both would read as a single pool, which is not what the state says.

action.description: The primary button, in the two shapes the run decision can take. Two captions rather than one parameterised caption: 'start a new run' and 'resume the run you are in' send the player to different places, and a screen that says the same word for both is a screen a player cannot read.

status.description: The line shown while the screen has no decision to offer. Two: the read has not answered yet, and the read said there is no such profile. The CAUSE beyond that is carried in code as a named state so it can be logged and told apart, while what a player is shown stays one honest sentence.
